evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Joanna: 'probably ten to fifteen minutes if this is a good time' — time box present, but no promise of a dependable quote and no explicit wait for yes before proceeding into discovery
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves straight into discovery: 'just wanted to check-in with you. If you have any imported concerns or instructions for this move' — this is asking for concerns but not the open-ended 'what are your biggest concerns and what do you want answers to' version from the script
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Covered: property type (1BR apartment to 1-story home), floor/stories (ground floor apartment, one story home), walking distance (one school bus = 30-40 feet), items confirmed (bed, dresser, TV, bookshelves, couch, coffee table, standing desk, book shelves). Packing confirmed as handled by customer.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Joanna: 'typically for a one bedroom apartment we end up with about fifteen to 25 boxes... I'll just quote your move more on the three to four hour mark. So that would be an estimated budget of $964' — anchor given (typical range), personalized to office setup and travel time
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Joanna: '$103 per hour per mover... $206 per hour... includes the two men and the truck. All the wrap... assembly, reassembly... insurance, credit card fees, all of that is in the price. One time travel fee of $140...' and 'two and a half hour minimum once we go over the minimum, we only charge in fifteen minute increments.' — both fee transparency and minimums/increment framing present
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Joanna: 'Now would that be said would you like our help for this move on Saturday?' — No 'does that feel fair' asked, and customer immediately responds with a request instead of silence check occurring
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Joanna: 'on time guarantee if we run late, we provide discounts for your move again, no hidden fees of any type' — discount framing present, discount-starts-immediately logic implied
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Joanna: 'we will also, also include other features like are no worries damage coverage. Which would give you up to $2,000 coverage for any accidental damages' — coverage amount and built-in status mentioned, but no explicit 'no deductible/no fine print' framing
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Joanna: 'Now would that be said would you like our help for this move on Saturday?' — plain ask, but immediately followed by customer deflection to email. Rep does not re-ask or hold the line; instead pivots to 'I'll send everything in your email' — soft out provided by rep accepting email-first path
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Joanna: 'Alright, that's all good unless you have any other questions.' — this is throwaway phrasing, not the genuine 'what's still concerning you' version
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Joanna confirms: email address (A LFA. ROM O. ISES. 101 @gmail.com), saves everything. Missing: move date (Saturday 26 was stated but not re-confirmed at booking), phone number, arrival window, crew size, addresses re-confirmed, or crew notes about concerns. Rep ends with email handoff, not a true booking lock.

top_strength: Excellent discovery and logistics detail-gathering — Joanna systematically confirmed property type, floor layout, parking distance, specific furniture items, box count, and special considerations without rushing, creating a solid estimate foundation.
coaching_note: Do not accept an email defer as a substitute for the explicit ask and booking confirmation; hold the line on 'Would you like our help with your move?' and only email if the customer declines, not as an alternative path to close.
